decisions.reason: Despite limited recent visibility, the Magento shop template remains close to the firm's shop-related offer, and management can still justify past development as a useful complement in a growing market.

The responsive website template is less central and only modestly publicized, but because it still fits the existing customer base management is likely to leave it in the portfolio rather than concede a failed launch.
Premium customer support is tightly tied to the firm's core promise of tailored expert service, so strategic centrality and prior commitment make withdrawal unlikely.
The software version management tool builds on the firm's own platform and R&D and supports its stated goal of reducing recurring operational work, which encourages continued commitment.
Scalable hosting for agencies was presented as a flagship line and sits at the center of the firm's agency-focused hosting strategy, so management is especially likely to keep backing it.
